title: Streaming JSON lines
hints: json.NewDecoder(r) reads one JSON value per Decode call and skips the whitespace (including newlines) between values.
Loop: decode into a small struct with a Level field. When Decode returns io.EOF you're done; any other error should be returned.
Count entries with an empty level under "unknown". Start with make(map[string]int) so the result is never nil.
